title: Vermont Skydiving Adventures
specs: Drop zone located on private runway with views of Lake Champlain and Adirondack Mountains
Operates Cessna 205 and Cessna 182 aircraft for jumps to 12,000 ft AGL
Mom and Pop operation with USPA rated instructors and FAA certified riggers
Tandem skydive within past 2 years required to start AFF program
Groups of 10 or more receive 10% discount per person on skydive (photo/video not included)

blurb: Guests can do tandem skydives with instructors attached, accelerated freefall training to become licensed skydivers, or jump as licensed fun jumpers. The drop zone operates with Cessna aircraft and offers camping on site. Video and photo packages are available for tandem jumps.
